newsitem.title: CANADA: Onex to buy HP Exeter business.
newsitem.headline: Onex to buy HP Exeter business.

text.p: Onex Corp subsidiary Celestica International Holdings Inc said on Monday it agreed in principle to acquire Hewlett-Packard's Exeter, New Hampshire operation. Financial terms were not disclosed.
The acquisition followed Celestica's agreement in principle in April to acquire HP's Fort Collins, Colorado printed circuit assembly business.
The Exeter operation comprises the system build, final assembly, test and repair facility for some of HP's workstation systems and other businesses.
It employs about 400 people, with revenues of more than C$750 million and assets of about C$140 million. The purchase is expected to be completed within the next few months.
Financing for the acquisition will be provided partly by Celestica from cash resources and through "an appropriate level of bank financing secured and supported by the acquired business."
